text: The organs to know. Underground stems: the rhizome of ginger, the tuber of potato, the bulb of onion, the corm of Colocasia. Creeping stems: the runner of dubo grass, the sucker of mint, the offset of water hyacinth. Leaves, in Bryophyllum. And roots, in sweet potato and Dahlia.
